acceptanceCriteria: each active installment card shows a +1 step button; tapping increments current_step and updates the card immediately
when current_step reaches total_installments after increment, the installment moves to the completed section
the summary card shows total remaining commitment (sum of remaining payments x amount for non-excluded active installments)
each installment card has an exclude toggle; when enabled the installment is excluded from the monthly total and total remaining commitment
excluded installments remain visible in the list with a visual indicator that they are excluded
